mapper.select: SELECT s.conversation_id, r.source_message_id, r.execution_id, c.command_id, s.scope_id, c.payload_hash, r.status, s.conversation_generation, e.event_seq FROM sq_command c JOIN sq_execution_scope s ON s.user_id = c.user_id AND s.scope_id = c.scope_id JOIN sq_response_execution r ON r.user_id = s.user_id AND r.execution_id = s.owner_id AND r.scope_id = s.scope_id JOIN sq_conversation_event e ON e.user_id = c.user_id AND e.conversation_id = s.conversation_id AND e.producer_key = CONCAT('command:', c.command_id, ':execution.queued') WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.scope_key = #{scopeKey} AND c.idempotency_key = #{key} AND s.kind = 'RESPONSE'
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_conversation SET message_seq = message_seq + 1, version = version + 1, last_activity_at = #{now} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT message_seq FROM sq_conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sq_message (message_id, user_id, conversation_id, message_seq, role, content, completed, execution_id, occurred_at, creator_id, last_updater_id) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{sequence}, 'USER', #{text}, TRUE, #{executionId}, #{now}, #{userId}, #{userId})

INSERT INTO sq_response_execution (execution_id, user_id, conversation_id, source_message_id, scope_id, binding_id, status, dispatch_sequence, creator_id, last_updater_id) VALUES (#{executionId}, #{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{messageId}, #{scopeId}, #{bindingId}, 'QUEUED', (SELECT message_seq FROM sq_message WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND message_id = #{messageId}), #{userId}, #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_conversation SET title_source = 'FALLBACK' WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND title_source = 'LEGACY'
UPDATE sq_conversation SET conversation_event_seq = conversation_event_seq + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT conversation_event_seq FROM sq_conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sq_conversation_event (user_id, conversation_id, generation, event_seq, producer_key, event_type, payload_json, occurred_at, creator_id, last_updater_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{generation}, #{sequence}, #{producerKey}, #{type}, #{payloadJson}, #{now}, #{userId}, #{userId})
